svg.text: SGHMC (mini-batch gradients) explores the weights θ ∈ ℝd
collect pairs (θj, log π(θj | D)) near the posterior mode
train Ĥ(θ) ≈ log π(θ | D) on the calibration pairs
one forward pass replaces a full pass over the data
dimension-robust proposal θ′ = √(1−β²) θ + β ξ, ξ ~ N(0, C)
accept or reject with the emulated log-posterior Ĥ
Why a short run is enough
The exploratory samples only need to cover the high-density region:
they are the emulator’s training data and give the sampler a
one forward pass instead of a pass over the data
accuracy and uncertainty match the full BNN at a fraction of the cost
short MCMC run collects training pairs
